title: Decks
intro: Decks fill your one big deck with words and let you review just a part of it when you want.
allText: Words from all active decks, most forgotten first.
empty: You have no decks yet. Create your own or add a ready-made one from the library.
archivedHint: Archived decks are paused: their words are not reviewed.
stats: {total, plural, one {# word} other {# words}} · {due} due · {fresh} new
deleteText: The deck will be deleted. Words and progress in other decks stay.
libraryText: Ready-made decks. Add one to yours so its words join your reviews.
noWords: This deck has no words yet.
removeWordText: The word leaves this deck. Learning progress is kept.

form.translationsHint: Several variants — separated by commas: revenue, income
form.required: Enter the word and at least one translation.
form.exampleHint: In the language you are learning. Optional.
form.suggestHint: Find a translation and an example in dictionaries
form.noTranslations: No translation found in the dictionaries — type it in yourself.
form.noExamples: No example found in the dictionaries — add your own or leave it empty.

import.title: Import a list
import.intro: Paste a word list: each word on a new line, then its translation and, optionally, an example. Before saving you can check everything, fill gaps with suggestions and fix it.
import.textHint: One line — one word: the word, its translation, an example. Two spaces in a row work as a Tab. Write several translations of one word separated by commas or "/". Tables from Excel and Google Sheets are tab-separated.
import.placeholder:
apple - яблуко - I eat an apple every day.
revenue - дохід, виручка - Revenue grew last year.
journey - подорож
import.separatorLabel: What separates the word, translation and example
import.found: {count, plural, =0 {No words found} one {# word found} other {# words found}}
import.nothing: No lines were found in the text. Paste a list and parse it again.
import.incomplete: A word and a translation are needed — otherwise the card is skipped.
import.skipped: {count, plural, one {# card without a word or translation will be skipped} other {# cards without a word or translation will be skipped}}
import.save: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to add} one {Add # word} other {Add # words}}
import.saved: {count, plural, one {# word added} other {# words added}} to the deck "{name}"

copied: {count, plural, one {# card copied} other {# cards copied}}
copyFailed: Couldn't copy: the browser blocked access to the clipboard.
